spans.s: Like, as (showing उपमा or comparison); वागर्थाविव संपृक्तौ
As if, as it were (denoting उत्प्रेक्षा); पश्यामीव पिनाकिनम् Ś.1.6. लिम्पतीव तमोङ्गानि वर्षतीवाञ्जनं नभः
Little, somewhat, perhaps; कडार इवायम् G. M.
(Added to interrogative words), 'Possibly', 'I should like to know', 'indeed'; विना सीतादेव्या किमिव हि न दुःखं रघुपतेः
; क इव of what sort, what like; क इव कालः
; what a long time has elapsed.

इव is frequently used with adverbs, especially with such as involve restriction, by way of emphasis in the sense of even or just so, just, exactly, quite, indeed, very; मुहूर्तमिव but for a moment; किंचिदिव just a little bit; so ईषदिव, नाचिरादिव, &c.; (इव is considered by grammarians as forming compounds with the word after which it stands; इवेन समासो विभक्त्यलोपश्च Vārt. on
. Sk.). -Comp. -उपमा f. A simile in which इव is used.
is given as an illustration of इवोपमा.
So large, so stately or magnificent.
